create.name: Dr. William Keepin
create.bio:
William Keepin, known as Will, is a teacher of interfaith spirituality and the co-founder, with Rev. Cynthia Brix, of the Satyana Institute and its Gender Equity and Reconciliation International (GERI) programme. He began as a scientist, with a doctorate in applied mathematics and a background in mathematical physics, and worked on energy and climate policy before turning to contemplative practice. He later took a master's degree in East-West psychology, holds a Findhorn Foundation fellowship, and has guided Grof breathwork sessions since 1989.

GERI brings women and men of all orientations together in facilitated circles to speak honestly about how gender has shaped their lives and to listen across that divide, drawing on prayer, silence and the truth-and-reconciliation model associated with Desmond Tutu. It now trains facilitators internationally. Through Satyana's Dawn of InterSpirituality project he has also convened gatherings of teachers from several faiths and offers recorded guided meditations on divine love and a free weekly online sitting. His books include Belonging to God, on a universal path of divine love, Divine Duality, and Healing the Heart of Humanity, on reconciliation between masculine and feminine.

books.title: Healing the Heart of Humanity: The Outer and Inner Alchemy of Reconciliation between Masculine and Feminine
books.author: William Keepin
books.description: His newest book on the gender reconciliation work he has led for over three decades. It sets the circle process within a spiritual frame and argues that relations between women and men are a place where deep collective change can begin.

courses.title: GERI Professional Immersion and Facilitator Training (online track)
courses.description: Satyana's professional training for people who want to lead gender reconciliation circles. The online track combines group modules with an internship; in-person cohorts run in four six-day modules in different regions.

free_resources.title: Guided meditations from Dawn of InterSpirituality
free_resources.description: Recorded meditations of five to fifteen minutes led by Will Keepin, among them a Flame of Love practice and resting in the heart.

free_resources.title: Weekly meditation and prayerful connection
free_resources.description: A free online sitting each Wednesday morning (Pacific time): half an hour of silent meditation and prayer, then a short spiritual reading and reflection. Open to all levels.
